title: Chapter 716
paragraphs: Chapter 716
Episode 180. Each One's Fight (6)
"Strawberry meat, no, Strawberry Pie! Are you okay?"
Owl immediately checked Gilly. The reflux was severe, but not fatal. He immediately took out poison and medicine from his bosom to calm Gilly's energy.
"Purify... purification machine. Dox's aura…."
"Mr. Owl, she can't die. Our Jini would be sad. First, we must kill this one!”
"Yona, stop. He's still someone who can be turned back with a purification machine."
"Can't we just kill him?"
"Dox is a Black Knight whom Jini personally sent on a mission here. Even if the corruption was voluntary, not accidental, it's right for him to pay for his crimes when he's sober."
"Hi, what a frustrating story. Strawberry Pie, what do you want to do? It's better to ignore Mr. Owl's order and go with your opinion. It's better to kill, right? Since he tried to kill you."
"No... Murakan… sir."
Gilly squeezed out the last remaining strength and answered like that. Her consciousness was so faint and she was so misled by the nickname Strawberry Pie that she mistook Yona for Murakan.
She missed him terribly because of the pain and hardship.
"Hehe, I'm Yona."

Yona, as if she couldn't help it, pulled out the sword of death that was stuck in Dox's body. Dox shuddered and tried to recover, but Owl purposely dripped poison on the wound to prevent body transformation during the process.
"Bijen, escort Gilly and the Black Knight to Zipple's fleet. Especially Gilly, she urgently needs treatment."
"Understood."
As soon as she heard that, Gilly lost consciousness. The last thing she saw was the sky behind the battlefield, full of Zipple's fleet approaching the battlefield.
Finally, the temporary allies were arriving one by one. Although Kinzelo is still not here, the arrival of Zipple's fleet alone changed the atmosphere of the battlefield in an instant.

"Fleets 3 and 4, prioritize securing prisoners. Fleet 5, transport the gathered prisoners to Cosmos' fleet from the rendezvous point. The rest should focus on eliminating the giant monsters, and prohibit bombardment in areas with many prisoners. Shatter cannons should be used only on monsters that do not have prisoners."
"Yes, Lord!"
"Contract mages from Ghost Squad 1 and Tower 1, work with the dragons to assist the Black King and Julian in rescuing the prisoners hanging on the monster's head."
Under Veradin's command, the fleet began to disperse. The giants had been aware of Hedo's attacks all along, but they showed a flustered look when the fleet's attack suddenly added.
The rescue operation was finally getting closer to the form the temporary alliance had initially planned.
The winds of reversal began to flow in each one's fights that broke out all over the battlefield.
Swooosh-!
A massive beam of light plunged into one side of the battlefield like a giant's spear.
The Emperor's Sword from Hairan, Bigi Sky-Piercing Strike.
It was where Alisa and Kujan were fighting. An earthquake shook the ground and a shockwave rippled, and Alisa and Kujan found themselves looking at the back of Dante who stood before them.
"Queen Alisa, Kujan. Are you okay?"
"Your arrival couldn't be more timely, Sir Dante. We were about to falter."
The other real Empire's First Sword, Dante Hairan, who had been attacking the two, and the Vermont Special Forces.
Starting with Lats, he glared at the squad leaders and mine units as if to tear them apart right away. The Special Forces members couldn't even properly point their swords at Dante.
The members who became mines are clearly strong, but Dante was a warrior on a completely different level from them.
Numerical superiority was meaningless before those who inherited the name of 'Sword Emperor'. Already dozens of mines that were rushing in on Sky-Piercing Strike turned into pieces and scattered.

"First, you turned a blind eye to the deaths of the Empire's people. Second, you tried to assassinate the Queen of Tikan. Third, you chose to abandon the Empire and humanity and become a dog of the imperial family and the malignant spirit. The punishment for these crimes is death, which I will personally execute…."
The moment killing intent was in Dante's eyes, V's head fell to the ground. The special forces leaders couldn't even properly perceive the moment Dante's sword moved.
At the same time, Sky-Piercing Strikes swept around in all directions, slaughtering the mine units. Chris was also cut into pieces in an instant and rolled on the ground.
Only Lats managed to dodge the sword energy from Rashid a few times, but that was all.
Squeak, Clunk! Suddenly, Lats' right hand holding a curved sword fell to the ground.
'I couldn't see it at all... Is this, perhaps!'
Intangible Sword, the Hairan's Sword Emperor technique that symbolizes Lon.
"Your masters will also be sent to hell soon, so go ahead and wait."
Dante's sword was already within that range. The scene of the Intangible Sword and Sky-Piercing Strike slaughtering the mines like crazy continued.
No matter how superior the mines' regeneration was, they couldn't survive from Dante.
Meanwhile, a pure white frost covered the battlefield of Lutan and the Youngest Division.
The Master of the White Palace, Syris Endorma, was unleashing the power of All-Freeze, leading the Seven Swords of the White Palace.
"Sir Luton Ferman."
Syris extended a hand towards Luton, who was on one knee and being overwhelmed.
For a moment, Luton mistook that hand for Talaris's.
In the past, Luton and the execution knights would often clash with Talaris and always end up subdued, and each time she would offer her hand to help them up, just like Syris was doing now.
"Hoof, huck... Archduke."
"After you joined Tikan, my mother often felt bitter. You guys didn't look for Hidden Palace when you were subdued, but she said you should have checked first."
- Yeah, I know. Don't blame me. If you had come to Hidden Palace for help after surviving...

- That's correct. We didn't come looking for you because we thought you weren't involved in this. As those of us who lived without people around us, you were the closest to us, but that objectively wasn't anything special. We were just a past connection for you.
The conversation between Talaris and Luton after Luton's surprise attack on Tikan and being subdued by Jin.
Since that day, Talaris had regretted not taking care of Luton and his group. So, she would occasionally tell Syris stories about them.
"... Is that so?"

"Since we're in the middle of an operation, it's only natural that I should support you, Sir Luton, but even if you were in trouble due to personal issues, our Hidden Palace would have stepped forward to help. Because you had a deep connection with my mother."
Luton looked up and looked at the profile of Syris. The friendship that Talaris had for Luton and his group in her youth was clearly reflected in Syris' face.
"So when my mother's treatment is over, please personally tell her to forget about what happened then. It's quite annoying when she brings it up every time she drinks."
"I understand, Archduke."

The appearance of Syris prevented the Black Sword Society from continuing their attack recklessly. Although certainly inferior to the prime of Talaris, her overwhelming coldness was imposing enough to suppress the Black Sword Society.
"Ryu, you go there and help Jin's knights... No, I guess there's no need for that."
Belop, Mesa, and Scout approached Luton's side. They had just defeated Carjin Romero and the Hass brothers and came to help Luton.
Also, a one-armed warrior and the rear guard, the youngest squad, were seen returning.
The one-armed warrior was the black knight, Mon. While Mesa and her group were fighting, they had requested Mon, who was rescuing prisoners nearby, for backup.

The four members of the Black Sword Society, who were quickly overwhelmed, continued to be cautious. It was already burdensome that Syris and the 7 Swords of Hidden Palace had arrived, but with Mon's arrival, there was no hope.
"Sir Mon, it might be a good idea for you to go and support Jin's knights and the outer city."
When Syris spoke, Mon immediately left the scene with Ruten and the youngest division. At this, the Black Sword Association seemed to be relieved, and Syris let out a chuckle.
"Why. Do you think you can handle the 7 Swords of Hidden Palace without Lord Mon? You brats of the grotesque."
As soon as the words were finished, the chill emanating from the Ten Thousand Ice began to amplify.
The members of the Black Sword Association hastily closed their mouths, about to shout out that a mere Sovereign like Syris could... The chill was instantly blocking their paths.
"I will personally show you what it's like to die trembling in hell-like cold…"
As the chill engulfed the area like thick fog, eight swords of Hidden Palace silently pierced into their lungs along with the chill.
"Keke... kekekek, kek! Kehit, ah, we're not dead yet...!"
Near the fortress, the Tona brothers were staggering to their feet. Myu and Anne frowned as they saw the Tona brothers, who should have been down at least ten times already, getting up again.

"Hooook, you guys are the real deal. Myu, Anne. Even enhanced by chaos, you still can't finish us off. Aren't you embarrassed? If it wasn't for the chaos, you guys would have already been killed by us. Definitely, you guys are beneath us."
"I don't understand why we've been scared all this time, heh, hehehe!"
The Myu sisters gritted their teeth. The sisters were feeling humiliated by the unexpected counterattacks from the Tona brothers.
However, the Tona brothers were now really at their limit. The Myu sisters' next blow would be something they wouldn't have the power to fend off.
But the Myu sisters' blow didn't get to kill the brothers.
"Knights, we are here!"
"Belop, Mesa... you guys."
"10th and 11th flagbearers. You held out well."
Thanks to the timely arrival of the youngest division and Mon, they joined the fight. The Tona brothers still groveled and paid respect to Mon.
[That one-armed bastard turns out to be a black knight, acting all high and mighty.]
[It's better this way, come at us all together. We will send you all to the afterlife. I was just about to explode.]
On the other hand, the Myu sisters showered Mon with abusive words.

"Here, the 10th and 11th generations are the real ones who resisted to the end as true Runcandel when the grotesque instigated the rebellion. However, you, who used to be the 8th and 9th generations, were the first to betray Runcandel."
Mon pointed his sword at Myu and Anne.
Myu and Anne felt an unexpected pressure from just that. The weight of the real Black Knight's helmet was not something they could handle. Even though he had lost one arm.
"Do you know why the family ranked the Black Knight higher than the generations?"
[You're flaunting an outdated law that has no practical value. The world has changed, my mother's Runcandel no longer treats Black Knights as special.]
"It's not just because of the merits. It was to guide and, if they fail to improve, eliminate lacking generations like you. Therefore, I will kill both of you from now on."
Not as Rosa, but as a Black Knight of Sirun Runcandel and Jin Runcandel.
With the continuation of his words, there was a glow in Mon's black helmet.
